name: Jian, Mo
bio: Jian Mo, specializes in the biosynthesis of natural products, exploring how complex molecules are synthesized biologically. His personal motto is: "Engineering life to synthesize the future".
affiliation: Professor, East China University of Science and Technology

name: Celine, Zhang
bio: Celine Zhang contributes to VCA-Prudens as a member of the iDEC team.

name: Chenfan, Wu
bio: I’m Chenfan, and biology is what I love most. From tiny cells to entire ecosystems, life in all its forms captivates me. I’m especially drawn to how nature changes and adapts over time. Fieldwork, data analysis, and solving the puzzles of living organisms are what I enjoy doing.

name: Yuxi, Bai
bio: Hey all, this is Yuxi Bai. I grew up in Beijing, China, and now I’m a student in the United States. This year is my first time taking part in iDEC, and I’m eager to learn new things while working with everyone. Here’s to a great year and a team experience we’ll remember.

name: Haotian, Lu
bio: I’m Haotian Lu. Fiction writing is one of my hobbies, and I also enjoy browsing business magazines for fresh perspectives and ideas. Cycling is how I unwind—it keeps me moving and helps me think more clearly.

name: Zimeng Jessie, Yu
bio: Hey everyone, Jessie here. I’m in my final year of high school, and this marks my second iDEC experience. Biology and chemistry are subjects I genuinely love. I’m looking forward to teaming up with all of you and seeing what we can accomplish together.

name: Xiaohan Sophie, Wang
bio: Hi, I’m Sophie. Chemistry has long been a source of fascination for me. That’s why I’m eager to take part in events where I can sharpen my lab techniques, face genuine scientific problems, and put useful solutions into practice. When I’m not in the lab, you’ll usually find me exploring other hobbies.

name: Kele, Zhang
bio: Hey, I’m Kele! I’d describe myself as lively and upbeat. Dancing, singing, and spreading joy are things I love. I’m always up for new experiences and different ways of thinking, and I try to lift the mood around me. My hope is that we’ll learn, grow, and have a good time while creating memories that matter.

name: Zhecheng, Yue
bio: Greetings, everyone—Yue Zhecheng here. iDEC is new to me this year, and I’m hoping we’ll all enjoy the journey. My strengths lie in business-focused work, leadership, and communication. I’m also good at coordinating people and helping a team stay on the same page. Having competed in several business and economics events, I hope to make a memorable contribution to this group.

name: Lingwei, Li
bio: I’m Lingwei. Biology has always drawn me in—I’m the type who gets excited about how living systems work. My main jobs on the team are bench work and keeping communication flowing. iDEC has been a real learning curve: I’ve seen what’s new in biological design, and I’ve also learned that teamwork and clear talking are what get you through hard problems. I’m glad to help, and I want to see our ideas become something we can actually show.

name: Fengwu, Wang
bio: Hello, everyone, I'm Fengwu. Biology is a subject I can’t help but be curious about. I usually take charge of experiments and help coordinate things in the group. When I’m not at the bench, I’m probably traveling somewhere new or hunting for good food. iDEC has been a valuable experience—it opened my eyes to frontier biological design and taught me how to communicate and cooperate when the team faces challenges. I’m ready to put in my effort and help turn our ideas into reality.

name: Lifei, Shu
bio: Hi, I’m Lifei—someone who can’t get enough of music. I’d say I’m cheerful, passionate, and pretty relaxed. Since this is my first iDEC, I’m really looking forward to joining all of you.

name: Shiya, Da
bio: Hello everyone, I'm Shiya. I’ve always been curious about biology and feel strongly about it. On the team, I mostly do experiments and help with collaboration. iDEC has meant a lot to me. It let me dive into cutting-edge biological design and taught me how to talk things through and work with others when obstacles come up. I’m excited to contribute and help our team make creative ideas real.

name: Muyan, Wang
bio: Hello everyone, I'm Muyan. I have a great curiosity and passion for the field of biology and have conducted research focusing on CAR-T cell development for cancer treatment. I mainly handle the experimental operations and collaboration within the team. Participating in the iDEC competition was a valuable experience. It not only allowed me to delve deeply into the cutting-edge of biological design, but also taught me how to effectively communicate and work together as a team to overcome challenges. I look forward to contributing my efforts and working with the team members to turn innovative ideas into reality.

name: Ruixi, Huang
bio:
My name is Ruixi. I am a high school student. I’m fascinated by synthetic biology and enjoy exploring how biological systems work. In my spare time, I love reading science articles.

For the iDEC competition, I help with data analysis for our team project. I also take part in discussing experimental ideas and sorting out our records.

I expect to learn from other teams, exchange creative ideas and meet like‑minded peers here. I hope our team can gain valuable experience and grow together through this event.

name: Yichen, Sun
bio:
Hello, everyone. My name is Yichen. I am deeply fascinated by chemistry and like to delve into molecular properties and experimental exploration. In the team, I am mainly responsible for conducting experiments and coordinating teamwork.

Participating in iDEC is a valuable opportunity. It prompted me to conceive an original chemical design, practice clear communication, and overcome difficult problems with my teammates.

I hope to contribute my practical ability to the team, work closely with my partners, and turn our creative ideas into solid project results.

name: Yiding, Yuan
bio: Hello everyone, I'm Yiding. I have a great curiosity and passion for the field of biology, and I mainly handle the experimental operations and collaboration within the team. Participating in the iDEC competition was a valuable experience. It not only allowed me to delve deeply into the cutting-edge of biological design, but also taught me how to effectively communicate and work together as a team to overcome challenges. I look forward to contributing my efforts and working with the team members to turn innovative ideas into reality.

name: Ruohan, Shen
bio: Hi, I'm Ruohan, also known as Shen Ruohan. My academic interests are in biochemistry, bioanalytical chemistry, molecular diagnosis and chemical biology. I like to explore how chemical details shape biological functions, and how directional evolution improves biological molecules and pathways. For iDEC, I can participate in topic selection, literature review, experimental design and report writing; I am also happy to learn wiki editing and other new skills. Participating in iDEC will be a valuable experience. This competition is a good opportunity for me to explore the frontier of biological design and grow through teamwork. I'm excited to contribute and help turn creative ideas into real results.
